treatments.title: Check-up and examination
treatments.summary: A full look at your teeth, gums and mouth, with advice on how often you need to come back.
treatments.whatHappens: Your dentist examines your teeth and gums, takes X-rays if you need them, and talks you through anything they find before agreeing next steps with you.
treatments.priceNote: Charged as an NHS Band 1 course of treatment.

treatments.title: Fillings
treatments.summary: Repairing a tooth damaged by decay, using a tooth-coloured or silver amalgam filling.
treatments.whatHappens: We numb the area, remove the decayed part of the tooth, and fill the space. Most fillings take one visit.
treatments.priceNote: NHS Band 2 — covers one or more fillings agreed in the same course of treatment.

treatments.title: Tooth extraction
treatments.summary: Removing a tooth that is too damaged or infected to save.
treatments.whatHappens: We numb the tooth and the surrounding gum, then remove the tooth. We explain aftercare and, where relevant, options for replacing it.

treatments.title: Root canal treatment
treatments.summary: Treating infection inside a tooth so it can be saved rather than removed.
treatments.whatHappens: We remove the infected tissue from inside the tooth, clean and seal the space, usually over one or two visits.
treatments.priceNote: NHS Band 2, whichever tooth is treated.

treatments.title: Crowns and bridges
treatments.summary: A crown covers a weakened tooth; a bridge replaces one or more missing teeth using the teeth either side for support.
treatments.whatHappens: We shape the tooth, take an impression, and fit a temporary crown or bridge while your permanent one is made in a laboratory, then fit it at a second visit.
treatments.priceNote: £332.10 on the NHS (Band 3); from £550 privately, depending on material.

treatments.title: Clear aligners
treatments.summary: Gradually straighten your teeth using a series of clear, removable aligners rather than fixed braces.
treatments.whatHappens: We scan your teeth and plan the full course of movement, then you wear a new aligner roughly every two weeks, with check-ins every six to eight weeks.
treatments.priceNote: Not available on the NHS for adults. Price depends on how much movement your teeth need.

treatments.title: Professional teeth whitening
treatments.summary: Lightening the natural colour of your teeth using a dentist-supervised whitening gel.
treatments.whatHappens: We check your teeth and gums are healthy enough for whitening, then either fit custom trays for home use or whiten in the surgery, depending on which you choose.
treatments.priceNote: Cosmetic treatment — not available on the NHS.

treatments.title: Dental implants
treatments.summary: Replacing a missing tooth with a titanium post fixed in the jaw, topped with a crown.
treatments.whatHappens: We assess your jawbone with a scan, place the implant under local anaesthetic, then fit the crown once it has fully bonded with the bone, usually after three to six months.
treatments.priceNote: Not available on the NHS except in rare clinical circumstances. Bone grafting, if needed, is quoted separately.
